label: Sustaining versus existential inertia: esse-dependence sibling and the rival price
summary: Note docs/notes/sustaining-vs-existential-inertia.md; module TruthCore.Causality.SustainingDependence, spec specs/sustaining-dependence.toml. (1) Sustaining sibling of 2068f91c, the formal next test of the lane F esse-root assessment (PR #1777, unmerged): 149ed837 is 2068f91c restricted to causes of esse that give the effect being at every moment at which it is present, in every history. It follows from contact c4661518 and a new open co-presence bridge ffcb81fb (result 1f2ae3c4), and with ce55210c it gives 2068f91c (result f8519735); both steps are transcriptions in the sense of invariant 16, so they record the connection and close nothing. 2068f91c entails the sibling (result 2574412d, relation e6d1be09). The bridge (a distinct cause of x's esse present whenever x is, in every history, is one x depends on for its being) is motivated by the Lewis/Stalnaker entailment from strict conditional to counterfactual; its history-coverage condition is untyped, and without coverage an originating parent that outlives its child is an ordinary counterexample. It also does not block vacuous dependence on an always-present cause of esse of any mode, so an always-present-root route to 2068f91c bypassing ce55210c is possible and unexamined. Controls 886615a9: the parent-child interpretation (originating cause absent after its effect's first moment) satisfies contact, the bridge and the sibling and falsifies ce55210c and 2068f91c; the bridge and contact are each needed; all hold together. (2) Owner-directed price map by direction of entailment. Checked in Lean: onset fa3e228b and parity 5b24ef26 give concurrent actualization for begun things f4850897 (result d2e4867c, a transcription), which 40a97664 entails (result 6d90f126, relation 413800c5); the inertial history satisfies onset and falsifies parity (controls part 5); given onset parity is f4850897 restated, and the rival's change-only counter-asymmetry is equally the crux restated, so parity adds no price item. Analyst arguments, not typed: the essence/esse union principle (q.3 a.7, statement 58445bd6) and the De ente c.4 / q.3 a.4 principle entail the crux only on a synchronic reading, which is 40a97664 renamed; their tenseless readings are satisfied by an originating cause. From the unmerged C* branch's own control: C* in the holding sense does not entail the crux; the respect-general holding principle would entail more, but the rival can reject it on independent physical grounds (inertial motion). Presentist actualist explanation forces a present explainer, not a giver. Finding, among the candidates examined: no independently warranted, non-re-presenting proposition shown to entail 40a97664; extrinsic inertia's price at the crux is one item, plus its own primitive of diachronic sufficiency for existence; the routes resting on the crux (ce55210c, 23e04ae5, 9469ab62, 8bf775e9, the new connection to 2068f91c, any C* reduction) are single points of failure, not price items. (3) Other tests: inertia's PSR variant is stable at local scope; physics is neutral at the esse scope and tells against a respect-general continuation principle only; explanatory depth favours conservation only conditionally on the crux; inertia posits fewer standing relations locally but not fewer primitive principles. Judgment: no discriminating test available at matching scope; both stand with prices; no revision of the 2026-11-18 cluster judgment. Also recorded strong_version_needed on 366a6ea3 (it needs 40a97664, not its begun-things restriction). Independent semantic challenge of the first draft (8f13b1e2a) found 7 P1 findings and a set of P2 findings; all were repaired, and two fresh re-checks of the repair (2ab01a53f) confirmed every P1 resolved, after which one remaining contradiction (a transcription called non-transcription in 4418bfa1) and three P2s were fixed (transcription labels, bridge coverage counterexample and vacuity scope, onset attribution, symmetric treatment of the two asymmetry claims, scope of the price finding, sense bridges, unmerged-branch marking).
blocker: The crux 40a97664 is unresolved against extrinsic existential inertia: every candidate test either presupposes one side's reading (parity, synchronic union, the change-only asymmetry), is neutral at matching scope (physics conservation laws, the cessation law), or bears only on a sub-version (Humean-law inertia, a respect-general continuation principle, a simultaneous persistence power). The co-presence bridge ffcb81fb has an untyped, unassessed history-coverage condition. Next test: type present-tense receipt (ReceivesAt v z x t) and a receiving-giving correlativity premise to test whether the present-tense reading of the reception definition makes 40a97664 near-analytic and moves the dispute to the reception bridge da72ae93.

current_assessment.scope: Sustaining causation of being against existential inertia (extrinsic and persistence-power forms) at matching scope, with the rival's itemised price by direction of entailment among the candidates examined; the sustaining sibling of 2068f91c and its co-presence bridge; the onset/parity typing. Side by side with, not replacing, the 2026-11-18 eternity-dependence cluster assessment (attempt 447838c8).
current_assessment.assessment: No discriminating test is available at matching scope; sustaining (40a97664, ce55210c) and extrinsic existential inertia both stand. Sustaining's strongest warrant is a coherent standing-dependence account that unifies origin and persistence under giving and explains present actuality; its price is 40a97664 as a primitive, concurrence d7f5a528 (no warrant on file) and reception da72ae93. Inertia's strongest warrant is that the shared causal law on change with prior actuality yields persistence, PSR-compatibly and with fewer standing relations posited locally; the history of mechanics is an analogical precedent only. Among the candidates examined, its price at the crux is one item (reject 40a97664; parity given onset and the synchronic union principle are re-presentations, and its own change-only asymmetry is equally a re-presentation), plus diachronic sufficiency for existence; the Humean-law sub-version also carries the explanatory-circularity objection. Only the onset/parity entailment is machine-checked; the other rows are analyst arguments or come from an unmerged branch. 2068f91c keeps its direct option (its lane F grade is unmerged and unverified here) and gains a typed connection through ce55210c, contact c4661518 and the co-presence bridge ffcb81fb, a chain of transcriptions on which it is no better than ce55210c and the bridge's coverage condition. ffcb81fb is positively motivated by counterfactual logic but its history-coverage condition is untyped and unassessed, and without it an originating parent that outlives its child is an ordinary counterexample; it is not graded further. Parity 5b24ef26 has no warrant beyond that of 40a97664. Nothing is established or defeated.
current_assessment.next_test: Type present-tense receipt (ReceivesAt v z x t) and a receiving-giving correlativity premise; test whether the present-tense reading of DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN with correlativity derives 40a97664, and whether the inertial interpretation satisfies correlativity while rejecting present-tense receipt. Success relocates the dispute to the tense of the reception bridge da72ae93. Separately, examine the always-present-root route to 2068f91c through ffcb81fb without ce55210c.
